caption:
Stock market news | SEBI confirms 65-year age limit for MII directors unchanged

SEBI clarified that its recent consultation paper does not propose any change to the 65-year age limit for managing directors of market infrastructure institutions.

This removes uncertainty for senior executives and signals regulatory focus on governance terms rather than age restrictions, maintaining stability in market infrastructure leadership.
